sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our long-standing partners in the region. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

In reviewing the recent correspondence, I noticed that your latest proposed price is higher than our previous offer of €50.90, which I assume was a clerical error. Because we deeply value our long-standing relationship and would never take advantage of a mistake, we stand by our previous offer of €50.90. 

For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. 

I am confident that we can conclude our agreement at this fair price, which reflects the traditional high quality of our foundry. Our team takes immense pride in the craftsmanship we deliver to you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
